title: OptiCloth
body:
**Overview**

OptiCloth is a Optimization + QoL Modpack for fabric that is inspired by Fabulously Optimized (https://modrinth.com/modpack/fabulously-optimized) but not built on it. My favourite mods in this modpack are Sodium, BactroMod, MiniHUD (Check the other mods in the verisons tab). 


**OptiFine Compatibility**

There are OptiFine features are in this modpack (cuz it's called opticloth). Most mods that require OptiFine should work using this modpack (OptiFine features replaced with individual mods).


**Usage**

These are pruely client-side mods so you can use them on any fabric/vanilla servers


**Will links come?**

If this gets 50 downloads I will update this more and add a wiki, discord link, download tutorial and bug report website.
